# PRE-DAY GATE on the causal book: trade only asset-days whose PRIOR session's mean |certificate| for that asset sits above a quantile of the training distribution.  Strictly causal — the qualifier is known before the day opens.

# gate_quantile 0.0 is the ungated book, so every other row is read against it.  Trade count falls with the gate, which is the point: the 3-4/week floor is a CONSTRAINT, and a gate that raises $/session while cutting trades below the floor has not helped.
